class: Contradictory picks on one multi-choice question
symptom: Premier Health, 1 October: 'I have experience in the following areas of Information Technology' was ticked 'I have no experience in the following areas' together with 'System Analysis/Installing/Design' and 'Security'.
site: Any portal with 'select all that apply' questions
root_cause: apply_answers applied every answer the page plan proposed for a question, one by one; nothing checked that a 'none' choice excludes the others.
why_tests_missed: Multi-choice tests gave one consistent answer per question.
fix: page_agent._without_contradicting_none drops a 'none' pick (none / none of the above / not applicable / no experience / I have no ...) when the same question also has a real pick; a 'none' pick alone stands.
prevention: Treat a question's picks as one answer and check it against the choices' meaning (exclusive options) before applying any of them.
